scripts.dev: bun run --cwd component build && cd dev && sst dev
scripts.deploy: bun run --cwd component build && cd dev && sst deploy --stage prod
scripts.format: oxfmt package.json component/package.json dev/package.json component/src dev/sst.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json component/package.json dev/package.json component/src dev/sst.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc --noEmit --target esnext --module preserve --moduleResolution bundler --types bun --skipLibCheck component/src/functions/connector/probe.ts
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint:check && bun run typecheck
scripts.tree: mkdir -p .tmp-tree && git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD   | sed 's|/[^/]*$||'   | sort -u   | xargs -I{} mkdir -p .tmp-tree/{} && tree -d .tmp-tree && rm -rf .tmp-tree
